intuition.title: Yb sensitization and Er emission
intuition.summary: The source identifies Yb as the absorber and Er as the emitter in the host lattice: 980 nm excitation is absorbed and energy transferred to Er. This is the proposed sensitizer–activator framework; no spatial dopant distribution or transfer rate is measured.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.

intuition.title: Balance crystallinity and particle growth
intuition.summary: The authors attribute weak as-made emission to poor crystallinity and the improvement on annealing to better phosphor performance. Higher temperatures ultimately cause growth/aggregation and reduced surface contribution. The selected 800 °C treatment is a reported compromise, not a universal optimum for all formulations.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
